title: phenotype-otel-backends — extensible observability backend registry imported to KooshaPari/phenotype-otel (2026-06-17 wrap-up)
adaptation_notes: Renamed package from `pheno-otel-backends` to `phenotype-otel-backends` to match the existing phenotype-* convention in this repo's dependency set.

Inlined the `Span` data type into the backends crate (originally came from a `pheno-otel` stub in the source worktree; the live `phenotype-otel` repo's `pheno-otel` package does not expose a `Span` type). The Span is now a backend-local data record decoupled from the OTLP pipeline; future versions can add From/Into conversions from the live `opentelemetry::trace::SpanContext`.
Removed the `pheno-otel` path dependency (no longer needed since Span is self-contained in the backends crate).
Downgraded thiserror from 2.0 to 1.0 to match the existing pheno-otel crate's thiserror version (avoids a duplicate-thiserror-version in the workspace).

Did NOT add the standalone `pheno-otel/src/lib.rs` from the source worktree (98 LOC) — the live repo's `pheno-otel` is a real OpenTelemetry bridge, not a stub, and adding the stub would shadow the real implementation.

Root `Cargo.toml` gained a `[workspace]` section with members = [".", "phenotype-otel-backends"]; the existing `[package]`, `[dependencies]`, `[[example]]`, and `[lib]` sections are unchanged so existing CI (cargo test --all-features, cargo build --example basic) keeps working.

public_api.phenotype_otel_backends::Span: pub struct Span { name: String, trace_id: String, span_id: String, start_time: SystemTime, end_time: SystemTime, attributes: Vec<(String, String)> } — backend-local data record (Serialize/Deserialize/Clone/Debug/PartialEq); constructor Span::new(name, trace_id, span_id); builder Span::with_attribute(key, value)
public_api.phenotype_otel_backends::Backend: pub trait Backend: Send + Sync { fn name(&self) -> &str; fn export(&self, spans: &[Span]) -> Result<(), BackendError>; fn health(&self) -> Result<(), BackendError>; }
public_api.phenotype_otel_backends::BackendRegistry: pub struct BackendRegistry with new(), default(), register(name, backend), get(name) -> Option<&dyn Backend>, list() -> Vec<String>
